items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Dean Martin and Joey Bishop.

ctx.x: And Dean Martin and Joey Bishop.

No Dean wasn't there. It was just those four, I think, that came in so you couldn't help -- Sinatra was looking all the way around, he looked at the band and he caught my eye. He stopped in the center of the dance floor and said, "Hey, Chief, come here." He came over to me, I couldn't leave the bandstand because the other guys were in front of me, so he walked over here, he almost knocked over the saxophone players to get to me. He remember me when we were in Italy when I was on a tour with him and he remembered.…
